title: Memory, Storage & Index Gate
scope: Local deterministic measurement of project memory footprint, storage growth, snapshot retention, cache health, and database index/reindex operations on the canonical Windows repository.

budgets.metric: project-scoped memory footprint (database size + thumbnail cache bytes) reported via PerformanceDiagnosticsSnapshot
budgets.unit: snapshot reports deterministic, non-negative values for assetCount, databaseSizeBytes, thumbnailCacheBytes
budgets.source: PerformanceDiagnosticsSnapshot over a disposable in-memory Drift database

budgets.metric: storage grows proportionally to written assets and is categorized without overlap
budgets.source: ProjectStorageAnalyzer over a temp project package

budgets.metric: snapshot/automatic backup retention budget prunes oldest automatic backups without evicting manual backups
thumbnail cache and search index remain bounded and evict deterministically
budgets.source: ThumbnailMemoryCache and SearchIndex bounded cache tests

budgets.metric: database integrity check, ANALYZE, OPTIMIZE, and VACUUM run without error and corruption detection reports index synchronization state

baseline.profile: PerformanceDiagnosticsSnapshot construction with assetCount, databaseSizeBytes, thumbnailCacheBytes, searchIndexHealthy, runningJobs, recentQueryMs, lastProjectOpenMs
image and cache file categorization with largest-file reporting
automatic vs manual backup retention with maxAutomatic=20, maxManual=50 budgets
ThumbnailMemoryCache LRU eviction and MemoryCachePolicy boundary
integrity_check, analyze, optimize, vacuum operations and CorruptionScanReport.indexSynchronized

bottlenecks.impact: Diagnostics snapshot reports database and cache byte metrics, not live process heap/RSS. Profile-mode DevTools heap inspection is required for true memory-bound detection.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Capture Dart VM heap metrics in a disposable native journey on release-candidate hardware.

bottlenecks.impact: ProjectStorageAnalyzer reports current categorized usage; long-term growth projection across large-project lifecycle is not modeled here.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Integrate storage growth projection into LargeProjectWorkflow benchmark fixtures.

limits: Process heap / Dart VM RSS is not captured by this local test gate.
Profile-mode FrameTiming and cold-start Native GUI responsiveness remain deferred.
Long-term storage growth projection across production-scale projects is not modeled.
hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain UNVERIFIABLE and belong to dedicated later gates.
This decision is not signing or public release approval.
